capabilities: resolve image sources via relative paths
extras: README contains no explanation of the plugin itself, only credits to talengu/obsidian-local-img-plugin and an Obsidian forum thread about displaying local images with tags; users must rely on the manifest description.
problem: Obsidian does not display images referenced through tags with relative paths, which breaks portable HTML-based image embedding.
summary: Renders images written as HTML tags with relative paths inside notes.
